Hey Product Hunt! 👋 I'm Ramana, founder of Youkti.

We are here to change the GTM and sales industry.   
  
Youkti is an AI-enabled revenue action platform that remembers every account and tells your sales team what to do next. The data layer is free.

Problem: Sales teams pay a fortune for data and still don't know what to do with it. Every feed metered by the credit, and a rep still opens their CRM on Monday guessing which account to work. Meanwhile deals slip quietly and nobody notices until the quarter closes. [...] Report
